title: Aldosterone and renin
what: This blood test checks two substances that control blood pressure and salt in your body.
why: When blood pressure is high and hard to bring down with medicines, when potassium in your blood is low, or when something was found in an adrenal gland.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in a few days
tell_doctor: All blood pressure medicines and water pills. Many of them change the result
If you take hormonal birth control
If your potassium was low in past tests
If you eat a lot of licorice or drink drinks that contain it

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Many blood pressure pills affect this test. Your doctor may switch them ahead of time. Do not stop anything on your own.

prepare.title: Salt
prepare.text: Eat as usual. Do not cut down on salt on purpose unless the doctor says so.

prepare.title: Morning
prepare.text: Blood is usually taken in the morning after you have been up and about for around two hours. Then you sit for a few minutes. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: A sleeve you can easily roll up above the elbow.

bring: Your referral or list of tests
A list of all your medicines and doses
steps: You sit quietly for a few minutes before the draw
A band is tied above your elbow, and you are asked to clench your fist a few times
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick. Blood fills the tubes in a few seconds
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
Take your medicines as your doctor told you
The doctor will review the result. Sometimes more tests are needed
red_flags: The puncture site is very swollen, painful, and red
Severe headache, blood pressure much higher than usual, or weakness in an arm or leg: call emergency services

faq.q: Why is my doctor changing my pills before the test?
faq.a: Some blood pressure medicines distort the result. The switch is only for the time of the tests.

faq.q: What if my blood pressure goes up after the switch?
faq.a: Do not go back to your old medicines on your own. Call your doctor and keep checking your blood pressure.

reminders.text: Aldosterone and renin test tomorrow. Take medicines as your doctor planned, and eat salt as usual. After you get up in the morning, do not lie back down.
